anomalies.observed: On the NAVC Peripherals sheet, the BMI088 IMU mode-select pin PS (pin 7) is tied to +3.3V, while the same block is annotated as an I2C device with addresses 0x19/0x69.
anomalies.expected: The specification states the BMI088 is used as an I2C IMU (accel 0x19, gyro 0x69). For the Bosch BMI088, PS must be tied low/GND to select I2C mode; tying PS high selects SPI mode.

evidence.quote: NAVC Peripherals sheet, U5 BMI088: pin 7 PS connected to +3.3V; note 'I2C address: 0x19 (acc) 0x69 (gyr)'
IMU (accel + gyro) ... Bosch BMI088, I2C addr 0x19 (acc) / 0x69 (gyr)

anomalies.impact: The IMU would be configured for SPI instead of I2C, so the accelerometer and gyroscope would not respond on the intended I2C bus, causing loss of inertial navigation data.

parsed.summary: The schematic contains a mode-strap anomaly on the BMI088 IMU: its PS pin is tied to +3.3V, selecting SPI, while the design specification and the schematic's own I2C-address note require I2C operation.
